records.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, `rss = SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` uses Ruby's open-uri without specifying any `open_timeout`/`read_timeout` or limiting bytes read. records.issue_text: Falling back to i.id when link is blank may store a non-URL identifier (e.g. urn:uuid) as embed_url, failing the ^https?:// guard inconsistently
records.rationale: In Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed, it sets `url = i.id` when `i.link` is blank or not `^https?://` (e.g., `urn:uuid`). That `url` is then passed to `TopicEmbed.import`, which immediately `return`s unless `url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`.
